# Learning Nim {.unnumbered}

This book teaches the [Nim](https://nim-lang.org) programming language in English, for readers who
have written code in another language (Python, JavaScript, PHP, Go) but have never used a language
that compiles to native code.

It is **not** a translation of the official documentation. The official docs are complete and
actively maintained; this book is a companion, not a replacement. If you are comfortable with
systems programming jargon, start with the
[official documentation](https://nim-lang.org/documentation.html) instead.

## What makes this book different

- **Every example runs.** Files under `examples/` are compiled and their output is compared
  automatically in CI. If a snippet in the book stops working, the build fails.
- **Code that fails on purpose.** Some examples do not compile, and that is deliberate: you learn
  to read compiler messages instead of avoiding them.
- **Output is written, not photographed.** All program output is text you can search, copy, and
  have read aloud by a screen reader.

## Versions

| Tool | Version |
|---|---|
| Nim | 2.2.12 |
| Book | 0.1.0 (draft, first chapter) |

## How to read

If this is your first time with Nim, read in order. If you have used Nim before, jump to
[Variables](chapters/variables.qmd) and continue from there. Every chapter ends with exercises;
answers are in [Appendix A](appendix/answers.qmd).

Versi Bahasa Indonesia: [Dasar Pemrograman Nim](/).

Book source and issue tracker: [github.com/nferdazel/nim-id](https://github.com/nferdazel/nim-id).
